nodes.label: Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. This memory preserves the 06-25 baseline as history and is marked superseded 2026-07-01 by artefact-pass2-design. Still correct and carried forward: the model emits no numbers, ever - weights are measured, downstream, with the v1 proof that only 21 distinct w_facet values existed, so agents cannot produce real weights; tag-facets are not routing - a facet describes the tag's meaning while routing is a separate downstream consumer; topic is not a facet - the phrase IS the topic, and what is left is centrality, chunk-local and sibling-relative degree; no hard filters in ranking, where mandatory means weight concentration plus the cap; and the guide link, where a facet is a concept both tag and prompt are measured close to, hard-validated across independent research lanes. Superseded by the pass-2 cut: 'facets = weight + direction, one edge per tag carrying the full facet vector' is refined to a facet being specifically a graded relevance dial, with things that answer 'which' not being facets; 'core measure = sibling comparison' is refined so sibling comparison is right for centrality rather than the facet value itself, giving three separate reference frames - value absolute, centrality sibling-relative, distinctiveness corpus-relative; and the instrument, where the 06-25 'measured by geometry' was never fully realized, because what is actually built computes graded facets live at query time with no baked per-tag facet vector in the graph at all. CANON_AUDIT.md 6.5 cites this file's 'topic is not a facet' as one of the three incompatible settled facet positions across the desktop memory
